title: Incremental DTD parser and parameter-entity source stack

Exact submitted UTF16 Consumed/NeedInput/progress beforeEOF, source cursor restoration/absolute mappings/CRLF/surrogate/EOF semantics, original initial location, active cycles even nullDepth, aggregate charge-before-work/persistence, cancellation and borrowed-input release. No whole external-input buffering.

Pinned/authored malformed/recursive/conditional/content-model/declaration tests across every short split and push-source boundary; exact/one-over quotas and cancellation; independent actual/approved parser inventory and common-only sample; fresh cumulative/API/reference/planning/owned checks and explicit allocation/performance evidence at known source with unchanged verified prerequisites.
